name: uxie-manychat-factory
description: ManyChat toolkit skills: design and build Instagram automations through the uxie-manychat-mcp server (flows, triggers, tags, fields; draft-first). The MCP server is configured separately in ~/.codex/config.toml (see README).

interface.longDescription: Skills that turn Codex into a competent ManyChat operator — design and build Instagram comment-to-DM and keyword automations, capture leads into email or a CRM, and keep everything in draft until you say go. The skills call the uxie-manychat-mcp server, which you configure once in ~/.codex/config.toml (see the plugin README).
defaultPrompt: Use uxie-manychat-factory to design a ManyChat comment-to-DM automation.
Use uxie-manychat-factory to list my ManyChat flows and their triggers.
Use uxie-manychat-factory to check why a ManyChat publish was refused.
